data.description: Discovered during the DC↔Cloud test-parity re-audit (epic 3e73-72b5-cff2-40f0). DC pins the empty-outbound-assignee behavior POSITIVELY: test_dc_unassign_751e.py::test_empty_outbound_assignee_actually_unassigns and ::test_unassign_co_submitted_with_an_editable_field_does_both. Cloud has the implementation (bug 85a1, src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/acli.py:359-364) but only a NEGATIVE unit test (mutate/test_assignee_validation.py::test_update_issue_transient_error_propagates_does_not_unassign). Gap: no held-out test asserting Cloud update_issue with an empty assignee routes to unassign_issue (not --assignee "") and co-submits alongside an editable field. Test-only; feasible with a fake AcliClient. Acceptance: add held-out characterization mirroring DC rigor.
data.title: Cloud empty-assignee unassign characterization (positive parity with DC test_dc_unassign_751e)
